recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD20 染色可見強膜狀陽性的 B 細胞聚集於血竇腔內，排成線狀與分枝狀的血竇內（intrasinusoidal）分佈，這是脾邊緣區淋巴瘤骨髓侵犯的典型樣式；但陽性細胞偏大、核仁明顯，也需考慮血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: CD20 strong membranous staining in B cells clustered within dilated marrow sinusoids
Intrasinusoidal pattern: linear, branching cords of positive cells outlining vascular channels
Positive cells are medium to large with round vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli
CD20-negative background hematopoietic cells and adipocytes between sinusoids
No discrete paratrabecular or nodular aggregate in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostained for CD20 shows strongly positive B cells located predominantly within dilated sinusoids, forming linear and branching intravascular cords, with CD20-negative hematopoietic elements in the intervening marrow. The positive cells appear medium to large with vesicular nuclei. An intrasinusoidal B-cell infiltrate is characteristic of splenic marginal zone lymphoma; however, the relatively large cell size in this field also raises intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, which the case history indicates coexisted. Correlation with H&E cytology, Ki-67, CD5, and clinical findings is required.

ddx.vs: Tumor cells are large with prominent nucleoli and high Ki-67 confined to vessel lumina, often CD5 or MUM1 positive, rather than small marginal zone cells.
Shows a diffuse interstitial fried-egg infiltrate with CD20, CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positivity rather than predominantly intrasinusoidal cords.
Also intrasinusoidal, but the cells are CD3+ T cells (usually gamma-delta) and CD20 negative.
CLL forms interstitial and nonparatrabecular nodular infiltrates of small CD5+/CD23+ cells rather than a sinusoidal pattern.
